releaseNotes: v2.12.0 — In-app updates + new download site

history.notes:
v2.12.0 — In-app updates + new download site

New:
- In-app updates: ArtNet Manager now checks for new versions on launch and can download and install the update for you — with a progress bar and a one-click restart. No more visiting the website and reinstalling by hand.
- "What's new" summary: after an update installs, the app shows you what changed.
- Update channel: choose Stable (default) or Beta in Settings to opt into early builds.
- New download site at apps.llcheesell.com/ArtnetManager. It always shows the latest version and links; the old page redirects here.

Improved:
- The download page now fills in the latest version and per-platform links automatically.

Note:
- Auto-update works from this version onward. If you're on an older build, install v2.12.0 once (from the download site) and future updates happen in-app.

Improved:
- Cluster failover is more reliable. When a STANDBY takes over, it immediately re-sends the current lighting state so output doesn't drop to zero while waiting for the next console refresh.
- If two PRIMARY units are ever detected on the network, you now get a clear on-screen alert (it used to resolve silently with no warning).

Fixed:
- A freshly-promoted unit's Art-Net stream is no longer rejected by some downstream nodes/visualizers right after failover.

New:
- Cluster priority is now operator-assigned (Settings → Cluster, 1–255, lower = preferred PRIMARY), so you decide which unit leads. Applies live, no restart.

Improved:
- Failover is far more dependable: leader election no longer depends on machine clocks (which could disagree across PCs and cause two PRIMARYs), a struggling-but-alive PRIMARY is now detected and handed over, and a stuck "no PRIMARY" state recovers on its own.
- Manual Promote is deterministic — promoting a unit reliably hands it control without split-brain.
- A degraded PRIMARY and critical local health are now surfaced so you can intervene.

Improved:
- The Signal Checker and LTC Manager windows are now independent — they stay where you put them instead of following the main window, and can be moved and sized on their own.

Fixed:
- A STANDBY unit could occasionally start sending DMX alongside the PRIMARY (doubled output / merge conflicts) after a network change — fixed.
- Recordings are no longer silently lost: write errors and low-disk conditions are now reported, and quitting mid-recording finishes writing the file cleanly.
- Scrubbing the timeline during playback no longer produces corrupted output.
- Changing the network interface or sACN universe list now takes effect immediately instead of requiring a full restart.
- The app no longer hangs on startup if the Art-Net port is already in use.

Fixed:
- Scrubbing into the middle of a recording now shows the complete, correct lighting state (previously only a few channels would react).

Improved:
- Recordings now store periodic full keyframes, which makes seeking to any point much more accurate. The file format stays backward-compatible.

New:
- The app checks for updates on launch and shows a dashboard banner listing every release between your version and the latest, with full release notes. Dismissals are remembered per version.
- Dev/beta builds get a friendly greeting instead of a misleading "you're up to date" message.

Improved:
- About → Check for Updates shows the same per-release notes, and the Download button links straight to the right release page.

New:
- LTC input channel selection (Settings → Timecode Source): on multi-input USB audio interfaces you can now pick exactly which channel to decode LTC from, instead of everything being downmixed to mono.

Improved:
- On a STANDBY cluster unit, the Forwarding settings are now read-only with a clear banner — they're managed by the PRIMARY, so accidental edits that would be overwritten are prevented.

Fixed:
- LTC output in 29.97 drop-frame mode no longer produces invalid timecode frames.
- Drift readout is accurate across minute boundaries in drop-frame mode.

New:
- LTC Manager can now mirror the timecode the main app already receives (default), so it doesn't need its own network port.
- New Sync & Drift Handling controls: resync threshold, behavior on source loss (mute or free-run), stall timeout, and a Force Resync button.

Improved:
- The output timecode card turns red when drift is out of tolerance and amber when the source is lost, so status is obvious at a glance.

Fixed:
- LTC output is now rock-steady, so receivers lock onto it reliably (previously the signal was disrupted many times a second and only locked intermittently).

New:
- Renamed the LTC Output tool to LTC Manager (Tools → LTC Manager).
- Output Channel selector: send LTC to a specific channel of a multichannel audio interface, with silence on the others.

Fixed:
- LTC output is now true mono, fixing decoders that misread the previous signal as corrupted.

Improved:
- macOS builds are signed and notarized by Apple, so they open without the "unidentified developer" warning.

Fixed:
- The app could fail to launch after a Permanent Shutdown — fixed.

New:
- Settings are saved to disk and survive restarts.
- Player shows the save-folder path with an "Open in file manager" button, and clearly handles a recording that was deleted outside the app.

Fixed:
- The recording save folder is no longer overwritten when saving general settings.

New:
- Signal recording and playback: capture multi-universe shows to the ANMR format and play them back with transport controls, repeat, and seek.
- Manual Promote to PRIMARY button for cluster control.
- About dialog with version + update check, and a bug-report tool that attaches a diagnostic snapshot.

Improved:
- Much smoother performance with many universes — the signal-flow view and per-frame work were heavily optimized, and a simplified view kicks in past 50 universes.

Fixed:
- Recordings no longer drop data when many channels change at once.

New:
- Cluster redundancy (PRIMARY/STANDBY) with automatic failover.
- Recording and player foundations.

Improved:
- Stability and performance groundwork across the recording and forwarding paths.

New:
- Signal Checker tool with built-in test patterns, integrated as a mini-app.

New:
- Signal recording and player mode (ANMR format).

Improved:
- Tighter Art-Net routing timing and lower latency jitter.

New:
- Forwarding with per-destination delay, and visualization improvements.

New:
- ArtNet Manager 2.0: Art-Net / sACN reception, merge, visualization, and forwarding for live production.
